name: Kingston Heath Golf Club
note: OSM-clean build (build-play-course.mjs from OpenStreetMap). Scorecard facts (SI/CR/Slope) overlaid via apply-scorecard.mjs since OSM carries neither. Par per hole comes from OSM (sums to 72; KH's published par). The members' card sometimes lists par 73 with the 1st as a par 5 — that's a third-party error, OSM/championship is par 72 with the 1st a par 4. Par-3 positions (5,10,15) match the card, confirming numbering. Hole 8's green is NOT mapped as a polygon in OSM (only a practice green spare exists), so it uses a synthetic green at the centreline end (approximate front/back); every other hole has its real OSM green. Hole 16's OSM centreline is ~17 m short of its green — extended to reach it.
